displayAddress: New York Square, Quarry Hill, Leeds
description:
*Not available to students for 2026 academic year.

The rent shown is what you will pay each month for the first 12 months of your tenancy, including a promotional offer on this specific home. The non promotional rent on this home is £1,450.00

With tech-enabled living, and health and well-being intrinsic to what we do, this is renting like never before. Deposit alternative available, fuss-free living, pet-friendly homes in the heart of Leeds cultural quarter. Not just bespoke interior designed apartments, but also state-of-the-art amenities including private dining room, residents lounge, co-working spaces, media room, 24-hour gym and two rooftop BBQ terrace.

So what are you waiting for? Reserve your new Moda home in Leeds NOW

YOUR APARTMENT

- One Bedroom apartment with open plan lounge, kitchen and dining space

- Spacious bedroom with space for a desk or additional storage

- En-suite bathroom with deluxe rainfall shower

- Cosy living with 3-seater sofa and dining space for four

- Fitted kitchen with integrated appliances

YOUR KITCHEN

Open plan, sleek and modern with quartz worktops and integrated appliances including touch control, ceramic, 4-ring induction hob, combi oven, stacked fridge and freezer and dishwasher. Additional washer/ dryer within utility cupboard. Room to dine with marble top effect dining table and four chairs.

YOUR LIVING AREA

Light and spacious with stylish herringbone blackout curtains. Plush three-seater sofa, media storage unit and small and large coffee tables with mirrored tops.

YOUR BEDROOM

Stylish bedroom including bespoke fitted wardrobes with full height mirror, hanging rail and storage. Ottoman bed with storage, feature headboard and 1,000 individual pocket sprung mattress made from natural materials and marble effect bedside tables.

YOUR BATHROOM

En-suite bathroom with contemporary porcelain tiling throughout. Deluxe sized rainfall shower with separate handheld shower, WC and heated towel rail, plus bespoke vanity cabinet with LED lighting.

Council Tax Band: C

Please note that utilities (including electricity, water, and heating, depending on your apartment), council tax, TV licence, parking (if required), and any optional extras or upgraded services are not included within your monthly rent.

Speak to our team to discuss the homes and offers currently available.
